title: Recent Commit Materialization & Crystallization Ledger — #257 through #283
purpose: Merge the Sep 18 build sequence into one durable project state. A commit is not treated as finished merely because code or data exists: its result must be owned, connected, populated enough to be usable, bounded by evidence/status rules, exposed through an appropriate reader or archive surface, and protected by validation or revision rules.

definitions.materialization: A carved concept becomes a usable project object: it has a canonical owner, concrete artifacts or population, typed interfaces/handoffs and a place in the House.
definitions.crystallization: A materialized object becomes durable project law or a durable bounded research object: invariants, evidence boundaries, public/archive expression, anti-duplication rules, validation and revision paths are explicit.
definitions.completion_boundary: Crystallized does not mean exhaustively researched. Open population, longitudinal evidence, case growth and falsification work may remain.

crystallization_gate: interfaces or handoffs to neighboring systems are explicit
evidence/status boundary is explicit where claims or real entities are involved
reader surface or archive route exists
anti-duplication and revision path are known
validation or a concrete test protects the result from silent drift

waves.crystal: The House can be stood in, oriented, traversed and populated without changing knowledge ownership.
Comparative symbols are typed before interpretation and routed as bounded inhabitants rather than rival centers.
Potato of Life is semantic center; Axis is spatial center; lenses and living metabolisms inspect the center without creating new owners.
Rooms, operators, tests, local centers, consequence, revision and repair form one self-correcting lifecycle.
Deep symbols preserve type/history boundaries and are subordinated to concrete inhabitants, institutions and relationships.
The project distinguishes accumulation from useful discovery and requires evidence maturity before synthesis is promoted.
Project operators can be tested against real entities without replacing source identity or evidence.
Durable beginnings are modeled through multiple clocks and reproduction, while hidden/illicit/intelligence material is routed through evidence-aware Below→Forge processing.
The public doorway expresses the canonical hierarchy instead of creating another competing map.

cross_commit_crystals.invariant: Potato of Life is the semantic center; Axis is the spatial centerline. Local centers are scoped and cannot become rival global centers.
Rooms/domain records own knowledge. Planes, compass, Timeline, House, maps and other views project owned material without stealing ownership.
Classify a thing as plane, terrain, regime, organism, material, threshold, perception layer, process, route or inhabitant before moral or vertical interpretation.
Knowledge → provenance/discernment → Door → Tree/Garden → Fruit → History/Revision → Repair/Forge → Seed/Return.
Seed → Foundation → reproduction → branching → Fruit → memory → refoundation/return. Foundation is durable generative memory, not merely a birthday.
Symbols and topology serve concrete people, institutions, records, relationships and cases; population has priority over adding another structural layer.
Below is not evil. Secret, private, classified, clandestine, alleged, investigated, charged, adjudicated, convicted and designated remain distinct statuses.
Cross-domain revelation is promoted only through source-grounded cases, counterevidence and a concrete test; resemblance alone is not identity or proof.
The public hierarchy is Potato → House → Rooms → Views/Works. Tim, Religion, Philosophy, Science and World are broad entrances into that deeper House.
